name: Tank Brigade
description:
About This Game

A bit of story…

The war has reached a stalemate. The Alliance of Republics is fighting tirelessly against the Iron Commander’s forces across every corner of the globe. You are sent to infiltrate the enemy’s defenses through a narrow strategic route recently uncovered by what remains of the Alliance’s intelligence network.

Your mission is simple… on paper: break through the front, eliminate a series of high-value targets, and help the Alliance regain enough ground to deliver the final blow against the Iron Commander’s expanding empire.

You’ll cross the frontier in a powerful, customizable tank that can be upgraded and equipped with a wide arsenal of weapons to suit your playstyle.

Replayability

Every new game offers a fresh experience. Levels, biomes, and boss encounters are procedurally arranged, ensuring that each playthrough feels unique. The order of challenges will change every time you roll out, keeping the battlefield unpredictable and exciting.

Looking for more? Try Survival Mode! A fast-paced gauntlet where you move along rails using different vehicles across land, air, and sea. The question is simple: How long can you survive?

Old-fashioned Multiplayer

The challenge too tough? Or maybe you're just feeling lonely on the battlefield? Bring a friend along with classic couch co-op, just like the good old days.
You can even team up online using Steam Remote Play Together, making co-op possible no matter the distance.
short_desc: Explore a tactical top-down tank shooter set across diverse biomes. Each run offers a unique experience with procedurally generated levels and a variety of powerful weapons to unlock.
